selection: These previously inspected frames are retrospective and include the user's observed failure intervals. Use their existing automatic prompts and the full-frame fused-window trajectories. The existing seq23 same-read experiment already uses the fixed inset-excluded viewport. No labels enter captures or replay.
verification: Reuse the established seq3 fused observer and replay gates, actual author fusion logic and checkpoint. Verify each new full-video observer trajectory and every mask against its saved fused-window reference. At each selected read, uniquely locate the full fused source feature and positional span, reconstruct the original fused skeleton and replay it and no-op exactly, replace only that span with its own raw skeleton, retain all attention keys, positions and pointers, and repeat replay in two fresh processes. limits: The sequences and target frames were previously examined, annotations may be incomplete, and a local substitution does not measure feedback into later frames or establish a full-video effect. Full raw-two versus fused trajectories differ in content and history despite matched key counts. No redetection, new threshold, new confidence gate or GT-derived inference input.
